messages:
Alana (People Ops): Quick poll — Mia's birthday is next Fri (Nov 10). Do we send a small desk plant to her hybrid desk :seedling: or a home snack box :cookie:? Also thinking a 30s surprise Zoom 'video hug' at 3:00pm PST. Vote with emoji or reply. If you want to chip in $10, react :money_with_wings: and I'll DM you.
Mateo: Plant for the win — she keeps talking about finally getting a cactus :+1:
Jen: Snack box! she mentioned missing good cookies from home last week :pleading_face:
Ravi: Can we do both? tiny plant + an e-gift coffee? :coffee:
Alana (People Ops): I don't want to assume budget >:$ — if we get 10 people contributing $10 we can do both. Otherwise pick one.
Jen: note — Mia's allergic to peanuts, so any snack box must be nut-free.
Mateo: oh good call, that swings me toward plant then.
Ravi: I'm in for $10.
Jen: in for $10 too.
Alana (People Ops): Awesome — that hits 3 contributors. I'll set up a short event and the payment collection.
HRBot: Scheduled reminder: `/remind @Alana to send birthday Zoom link on 2026-11-10 14:30 PST`
Alana (People Ops): Plan A: send desk plant (nut-free snack add-on only if more contributions come in). Plan B: 30s surprise Zoom at 3:00pm PST. I'll create a calendar invite and post the join link here. DM me if you want to write a 1-line shoutout to read on the call. :party_parrot: 
Mateo: I'll bring the plant to the office and leave on Mia's desk Tue morning (I'll be in Tues/Thu).
Jen: I'll draft a 2-line message and DM it.
Ravi: Can you set the Zoom to mute participants by default? I don't want it to become chaos :sweat_smile:
Alana (People Ops): Yep — I'll set the meeting to muted and enable spotlight for the person reading. Thanks everyone!
